 Oral Order

15 16-05-2023 It is the petitioner's case that under the Government Scheme of Mukhyamantri Sahari Nali Gali Sat Nischay Yojana, RCC drainage of 300 feet from Babuniya More to Daha River, petitioner's land,
appertaining to Khata No. 12, Plot No. 451, 448, 448/563, admeasuring 19 dhurs 15 dhurkis, situate near Siwan-Babuniya More, has been utilized unauthorisedly without resorting to any land acquisition proceeding or paying compensation by Nagar Parishad, Siwan.

entities.text: Government Scheme of Mukhyamantri Sahari Nali Gali Sat Nischay Yojana
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is not in dispute that the petitioner's land has been utilized for construction of the said drainage without undertaking any land acquisition proceeding in accordance with law.
Patna High Court CWJC No.2560 of 2020(15) dt.16-05-2023

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Nagar Parishad has submitted that in respect of the area of land belonging to this petitioner utilized for construction of RCC drainage, the Nagar Parishad shall soon take steps for acquisition of land.
He has submitted that the petitioner can claim compensation in respect of only such land over which he has title and has in fact been utilized by the Nagar Parishad for construction of RCC drainage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In such view of the matter, this application is disposed of with a direction to the respondent Nagar Parishad to take immediate steps for payment of compensation to the petitioner after acquisition of land in accordance with law within a period of three months from today.

It is an admitted fact that Nagar Parishad has paid certain amount to the petitioner against taking possession over the land, but not in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner agrees that the petitioner may be paid due amount of compensation after adjusting the amount, which has already been paid to him.

Patna High Court CWJC No.2560 of 2020(15) dt.16-05-2023 This writ application stands disposed of with the aforesaid directions and observations.
(Chakradhari Sharan Singh, J) Pawan/-
